ref.substituent_description: A 3-chloro-2-fluorophenyl ring (C1 bears CH2-NH, F at C2 ortho to the CH2, Cl at C3 meta to the CH2) is linked via CH2NH-C(=O)-CH2-N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2 to the N1 of an indole. The indole carries an acetyl (Ac) at C3 and, at C5 of the benzo ring, a CH2-C(=O) group joined to the nitrogen of a piperidine ring that has two F atoms on the same carbon (3,3-difluoro, the carbon two atoms from N).
ref.notes: Typeset skeletal structure; three C=O, one indole C2=C3 and six Kekule double bonds in the two benzene rings.

wrong.substituent_description: An indole-type bicycle (five-membered ring with N and one drawn C=C, fused to a circled benzene) carries Ac on the pyrrole carbon next to the ring-fusion carbon; the ring N carries CH2-C(=O)-N(iPr)-CH2-C(=O)-NH-CH2-aryl, where the aryl is a circled benzene attached at C1 with F at C2 (ortho) and Cl at C3 (meta, next to F). On the benzo ring, the carbon next to the N-bearing fusion carbon (indole C7) carries CH2-C(=O)-N of a piperidine that has two F on the carbon next to the ring N (3,3-difluoro); a bond stub at the right image edge (indole C5) may carry a cut-off substituent.

correct.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) carries a CH2 (leading to NH-C(=O)-CH2-N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2-) at one carbon, F on the adjacent (ortho) carbon, and Cl on the next carbon after that (meta to the CH2, ortho to the F), i.e. 2-F, 3-Cl relative to the CH2. The chain ends on the N of a bicyclic indole-like ring (5-ring with N and a C2=C3 double bond; fused 6-ring drawn with a circle) that has Ac on C3 and a CH2-C(=O)-N group at C5 of the benzo ring, where the N belongs to a 6-membered ring (N, CH2, CF2, CH2, CH2, CH2) carrying two F on the carbon beta to N (3,3-difluoro).

correct.notes: Three C=O drawn as double bonds plus one C=C in the five-membered ring of the indole-like unit; no stereo marks. Atoms bearing no label are skeletal vertices.

ref.substituent_description: A 3-chloro-2-fluorobenzyl group (CH2 at C1, F at C2, Cl at C3) is bonded through NH-C(=O)-CH2- to an N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2- unit whose CH2 is on the N1 of an indole. The indole has Ac at C3 and, at C5, a CH2-C(=O) group acylating the N of a piperidine that carries two F on C3 (the second ring atom away from N, via the CH2 next to N).
ref.notes: Typeset reference-style drawing. Double bonds: 3 in the benzene ring, 4 in the indole (C2=C3 plus three in the benzo ring), 3 C=O.
